proposal.summary: MXsecurity versions prior to 1.0.1 contain an authentication bypass vulnerability due to insufficiently random values in the web service authenticator, enabling a remote attacker to access the system.
proposal.cwe_quote: if the web service authenticator has insufficient random values.

AV.quote: A remote attacker might access the system if the web service authenticator has insufficient random values.

PR.quote: A remote attacker might access the system if the web service authenticator has insufficient random values.

C.quote: There is a vulnerability in MXsecurity versions prior to 1.0.1 that can be exploited to bypass authentication.

I.quote: There is a vulnerability in MXsecurity versions prior to 1.0.1 that can be exploited to bypass authentication.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request technical details and proof-of-concept from the reporter: exact authenticator token name/location (cookie, header, parameter), how randomness is insufficient (predictable values or low entropy), and steps to reproduce; collect affected build identifiers and whether exploitation requires prior authentication.
